summary: First Extreme-owned target graph probe passed all eight ranks and eight real-weight cycles with exact state/host-mirror parity, identical rank state, no ModelRunner retained and no oracle target calls. Dispatcher-selected mode replay reduced median cycle wall from the refined eager 433.587 ms to 70.803 ms; internal decode-window rate rose from 38.27 to 277.18 tok/s. Longer steady run required before promotion.
